relationships.subject: GLI2
relationships.evidence_quote: This downregulation is triggered by decreased binding of GLI2 to the Pcif1 promoter.

relationships.subject: PCIF1
relationships.evidence_quote: Knocking out or conditionally deleting Pcif1 in ACC neurons reduces the m<sup>6</sup>Am level of Gap43 mRNA, leading to the increased expression of GAP43

relationships.subject: Gap43
relationships.evidence_quote: knocking down GAP43 suppresses the pre-LTP oversaturation caused by PCIF1 reduction

key_findings: Peripheral inflammation reduces PCIF1 in mouse ACC via decreased GLI2 binding to the Pcif1 promoter.
PCIF1 loss lowers Gap43 m6Am, raising GAP43 and pre-LTP oversaturation, causing inflammatory pain and anxiety.
